name: TurboTenant
positioning: Free for the landlord, paid by the applicant — the model that put full rental tooling in the hands of people with three doors.
description: TurboTenant offers listing syndication, online rental applications, tenant screening, state-specific lease agreements, e-signature, rent collection and expense tracking, with a free core tier funded largely by applicant-paid screening fees and premium add-ons.
real_estate_use: The independent landlord's problem is not scale, it is competence: writing a compliant lease, running a legitimate credit and background check, and documenting rent payment for tax time. TurboTenant packages exactly those steps, which is why a very large number of small US landlords never buy property management software at all.
features: Listing syndication to major rental sites
Online rent collection with automatic reminders
Expense and income tracking for tax reporting

use_cases.job: Advertise, screen, lease and collect rent on a handful of units at almost no cost
Produce a compliant state-specific lease without a lawyer for each renewal
